LanguageData.PhobosLitter_NoKit: {VEHICLE} has no litter kit. A mechanic can fit one in the fittings and tunes.
LanguageData.PhobosLitter_NotDowned: {PATIENT} is not down. Litters are for people who cannot walk.
LanguageData.PhobosLitter_NotHere: {VEHICLE} is not standing on this map.
LanguageData.PhobosLitter_Airborne: {VEHICLE} is in the air. Land it first.
LanguageData.PhobosLitter_Unloaded: {COUNT} people were set down from the litters of {VEHICLE}.
LanguageData.PhobosLitter_SetDownLeaving: {VEHICLE} is leaving by land: the {COUNT} people on its litters were set down where it stood.
LanguageData.PhobosLitter_UnloadGizmoDesc: Set the {COUNT} people on the litters down beside the vehicle, for a doctor to take to bed.
LanguageData.PhobosLitter_CollectGizmoDesc: While this is on, doctors carry downed people to this vehicle's litters when it is nearer than their bed, or when they have no bed, until every litter is taken. Anyone bleeding badly is treated where they lie first if a field medic is at hand. Fly them home, then use Unload casualties for the short carry to bed.
LanguageData.PhobosLitter_CollectOn: {VEHICLE} is taking casualties aboard: doctors bring downed people here when it is nearer than their bed.
LanguageData.PhobosLitter_CollectOff: {VEHICLE} is no longer taking casualties aboard. Anyone already on its litters stays there.
LanguageData.PhobosLitter_CollectFull: Every litter aboard {VEHICLE} is taken. Doctors take the next casualties to bed.
